specialities.name: Banana chips
specialities.why: Thinly sliced raw plantains fried in pure coconut oil until crisp, forming the quintessential Kerala snack.

specialities.name: Kozhikode halwa
specialities.why: A translucent, gelatinous sweet made from maida, sugar, and generous amounts of ghee, available in flavors like black coconut sugar and banana.

specialities.name: Palada payasam
specialities.why: A rich ceremonial dessert made of rice ada, milk, and sugar, slow-cooked for hours until it turns a deep pink caramel hue.

specialities.name: Kathakali mask
specialities.why: Ornately painted wooden or papier-mâché masks representing the iconic classical dance-drama characters of Kerala.

specialities.name: Kasavu saree
specialities.why: The traditional handloom off-white cotton saree distinguished by its striking real gold or copper zari border.

specialities.name: Houseboat stay
specialities.why: Cruising the serene, palm-fringed backwaters of Alleppey or Kumarakom aboard a traditional converted Kettuvallam.
